ModMetaData.name: Shift Change
ModMetaData.author: MrBeverage
ModMetaData.description:
REQUIRES ODYSSEY (for the outfit stand) AND HARMONY.
Colonists change into the right clothes for the room they work in, and back out again afterwards.
Put a vanilla outfit stand in a work room and put a work outfit on it. When a colonist takes on automatic work of that room's kind — doctoring in the hospital, researching or synthesizing drugs in the lab, cooking in the kitchen — they change into the stand's outfit before starting, and change back when their work takes them elsewhere. Their own clothes wait in the stand and come back exactly as they were, force-worn markers included.
Rooms are read from their role, so hospitals, laboratories, kitchens, workshops and barns all work with no setup at all.
That is the whole setup. Two optional controls per stand: - Shared (set owner) reserves a stand for one colonist. Left unassigned, a stand is shared by whoever is free to use it, like beds — so a kitchen needs one stand per cook working at once, not one per cook. - Set work types opens a checklist for rooms the game reads oddly, rooms that do two jobs, or a decorative stand you do not want used at all.
Leave the stand's Allow removing items toggle off, which is its default. Colonists stock the stand either way and shift changes ignore the setting entirely, so nothing here needs it on — while turning it on lets any colonist's outfit optimizer take the uniform and wear it as everyday clothes.
Deliberately narrow, so it never fights you: - Automatic work only. Ordering a doctor to tend someone right now never sends them across the base to change first, and a colonist already in uniform keeps it on for a direct order. - Emergencies are never delayed, and nothing happens while the map is under threat. - Nobody takes clothes out of a stand somebody else is using. - Passing through a room changes nothing — only doing the room's work does. - A meal break gets them out of uniform first, unless the food is already in their hands or their pack. - If a stand frees up while someone is already working in its room out of uniform, they step over and change — unless they are mid-treatment on a patient. - A Change back button appears on any colonist currently in a uniform, for when you want them out of it now.
One setting: Unassigned stands are shared, on by default.
Adds no clothing, no buildings and no art of its own — it uses the vanilla outfit stand and whatever apparel you put on it.
Worth knowing before you build one: vanilla has no scrubs, no lab coat and no chef's whites, so there is very little to actually dress anyone in. Any apparel mod fixes that.
